questions.title: Most Wind Turbines
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most utility-scale wind turbines installed.
questions.disclaimer: Counts operating utility-scale (>=100 kW) turbines only; excludes small distributed and residential turbines. DC not included (source omits it).

questions.title: Most Electric Vehicle Registrations
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most registered plug-in electric vehicles (BEVs).
questions.disclaimer: Counts light-duty battery-electric vehicles registered in the state; excludes plug-in hybrids in some tallies. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center — EV Registrations by State

questions.title: Most High-Hazard Potential Dams
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most dams classified as high-hazard-potential by the National Inventory of Dams.
questions.disclaimer: 'High-hazard-potential' means failure would likely cause loss of life; it is not a measure of a dam's current condition. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Most Federally Listed Endangered Species
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most federally listed endangered species under the Endangered Species Act.
questions.disclaimer: Counts species federally listed as endangered whose current range includes the state; a species can be counted in multiple states. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Fish & Wildlife Service — ECOS Species by State

questions.title: Most Toxic Release Inventory Pounds
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most total on-site and off-site toxic chemical releases reported to the EPA Toxics Release Inventory.
questions.disclaimer: TRI-reported releases include air, water, land, and off-site transfers; a small number of large mining sites can dominate a state's total. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US EPA — Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) National Analysis

questions.title: Most Battery Storage Capacity
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the largest utility-scale battery storage power capacity installed.
questions.disclaimer: Utility-scale (>=1 MW) battery storage nameplate power capacity, measured in megawatts (MW); excludes behind-the-meter residential and commercial batteries. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Energy Information Administration — Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory

questions.title: Most Wildfire Acres Burned Annually
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most acres burned by wildfires per year, based on a recent multi-year average.
questions.disclaimer: Annual acres burned averaged across 2013-2022; includes both natural and human-caused wildfires but excludes prescribed burns. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: National Interagency Fire Center — Annual Wildland Fire Statistics

questions.title: Most Groundwater Withdrawals
questions.prompt: Name the US states that withdraw the most fresh groundwater each day for all uses combined.
questions.disclaimer: Total fresh groundwater withdrawals across all use categories (irrigation, public supply, industrial, thermoelectric), in millions of gallons per day. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: USGS — Estimated Use of Water in the United States

questions.title: Highest Cotton Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most upland cotton by bales.
questions.disclaimer: Upland cotton, measured in 480-lb bales. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USDA NASS — Cotton Production by State

questions.title: Highest Rice Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most rice by hundredweight.
questions.disclaimer: Long-, medium-, and short-grain rice combined; measured in hundredweight (cwt). DC not included (source omits it).

questions.title: Highest Peanut Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most peanuts by pounds.
questions.disclaimer: All peanut types (runner, virginia, spanish, valencia) combined; measured in pounds harvested. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USDA NASS — Peanuts Production by State

questions.title: Highest Apple Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most apples by pounds.
questions.disclaimer: Utilized production; measured in pounds harvested. DC not included (source omits it).

questions.title: Highest Potato Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most potatoes by hundredweight.
questions.disclaimer: All potato types combined; measured in hundredweight (cwt). DC not included (source omits it).

questions.title: Highest Wheat Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most wheat by bushels.
questions.disclaimer: All wheat classes combined (hard red winter, soft red winter, hard red spring, durum, white); measured in bushels. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USDA NASS — Wheat Data by State

questions.title: Highest Sorghum Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most grain sorghum by bushels.
questions.disclaimer: Grain sorghum (milo); measured in bushels harvested. DC not included (source omits it).

questions.title: Highest Sunflower Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most sunflower seeds by pounds.
questions.disclaimer: Oil-type and non-oil (confection) sunflowers combined; measured in pounds harvested. DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: USDA NASS — Crop Production Annual Summary
